BREAKING: 5 men have been arrested in the UK near RAF Fairford, the airbase used by the US to strike Iran, on suspicion of explosive and terrorism offences. 

The UK had authorised US bombers there to hit Iranian missile sites accused of attacking ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
